description: Post a new comment on a List. Optionally assign it to a user and notify watchers. Returns the created comment's id. Use for List-level notes that don't belong to a specific task.

assignee.description: User ID to assign this comment to.

comment_text.description: The comment body text (plain text or ClickUp markdown).

list_id.description: ID of the List to comment on.

notify_all.description: If true, notify everyone with access to the List; otherwise only the assignee is notified.

name: create_list_comment
